author: MAE MAE
text: Great and professional work! Came out got right to work, any questions I had answered them fully, very informative, quick to diagnose the problem and what he had to do to find the solution.. overall respectable work.

author: Cole Buttry
text: Very professional came out to my commercial project and took care of a backed up sanitary system. Got it fixed in 10 minutes where a known name company I called out previously said it couldn’t be unclogged without digging up the line! Highly recommend!!

author: chris mit
text: Derrick and his co-worker did an AMAZING job on my mechanical sewer! They were able to come out a day ahead of schedule and had great communication. They took the time to explain the problem and repair options. I will definitely use them again!

author: Jeremiah Hazi
text: Dependable plumbing came out quickly and diagnosed the problem. When I called they said the cost for them coming out was 269.00. Also said that the 269.00 would go toward any additional services they may need to provide. The technicians arrived and said I needed to have the septic tank pumped. I asked when they could do it and they said their truck was down. They told me they would call the next day and let me know when they could pump the tank. I waited most of the day then called them back. The guy said his boss was out of town and he would call me on Monday. I didn’t not receive a call back on Monday. I called them back several times with no answer or any further communication. I paid 269.00 for 30 minutes of work and never heard back from them. This is not the way to do business and I will never use their services again. # UN-Dependable plumbing.

author: Phillip Jackson
text: This company really helped us out of a bind, my sink was stopped up. One call to Dependable Drain And Plumbing 🪠 and my problem was resolved in record timing. Mr. Vinny and and his co-worker worked us into their schedule in the same day. Thank you all.
